definitions.age: the length of time that a person or thing has existed.
definitions.are: a metric unit of measurement, equal to 100 square metres.
definitions.awe: a feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder.
definitions.ear: the organ of hearing and balance in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this.
definitions.egg: an oval or round object laid by a female bird, reptile, fish, or invertebrate and containing an ovum which if fertilized can develop into a new organism.
definitions.era: a long and distinct period of history.
definitions.erg: a unit of work or energy, equal to the work done by a force of one dyne when its point of application moves one centimetre in the direction of action of the force.
definitions.gear: a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of an engine and the speed of the driven parts (e.g. wheels).
definitions.sage: an aromatic plant with greyish-green leaves used as a culinary herb, native to southern Europe and the Mediterranean.
definitions.sea: the expanse of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface and surrounds its land masses.
definitions.sear: burn or scorch with a sudden intense heat.
definitions.sew: join, fasten, or repair by making stitches with a needle and thread or a sewing machine.
definitions.swagger: walk or behave arrogantly or self-importantly.
definitions.swear: state or promise solemnly or on oath.
definitions.wage: a fixed regular payment for work, typically paid on a daily or weekly basis.
definitions.ware: pottery, typically that of a specified type.
definitions.wear: have (something) on one's body or a part of one's body as clothing, decoration, or protection.
